speaker: Terese
text: Carol……？
text_en: Carol...?

speaker: Carol
text: 是我。小点声，外面还有——
text_en: It's me. Keep your voice down. There's still—

speaker: 旁白
text: 她没等Carol说完，便扑过来，紧紧抱住了她。
text_en: Before Carol could finish, Terese rushed over and hugged her tightly.

speaker: Terese
text: 你真的来了……
text_en: You really came...

speaker: Carol
text: 喂……你先松一点，我快喘不过气了。
text_en: Hey... loosen up a little. I can barely breathe.

speaker: 旁白
text: Carol的手在半空停了一下，还是落在她背上，轻轻拍了两下。
text_en: Carol's hand paused in midair, then settled on her back and gently patted her twice.

speaker: Terese
text: 对不起，让你跑到这种地方来。
text_en: I'm sorry you had to come all the way here.

speaker: Terese
text: 可我真的好高兴。听见开门声的时候，我还以为又是他们。
text_en: But I'm so glad. When I heard the door, I thought it was them again.

speaker: Carol
text: 都敢给我发求救消息了，现在还说这些。
text_en: You sent me a distress message, and now you say that?

speaker: Terese
text: 谢谢你来找我。
text_en: Thank you for coming for me.

speaker: Terese
text: 我一直在想，只要能再见到你，我一定要告诉你——
text_en: I kept thinking, if I saw you again, I would tell you—

speaker: Terese
text: 你对我很重要。我真的很珍惜你，不只是今天。
text_en: You mean a lot to me. I cherish you, not just today.

speaker: Carol
text: ……突然说这么认真干什么。
text_en: ...Why are you getting so serious all of a sudden?

speaker: Terese
text: 因为我怕以后没机会说。
text_en: Because I was afraid I might never get the chance.

speaker: Carol
text: 别胡说。
text_en: Don't say that.

speaker: 旁白
text: Carol抱着她的手收紧了一瞬。
text_en: Carol's arms tightened around her for a moment.

speaker: Carol
text: 我都找到这里了，就会带你出去。
text_en: I found you. I'll get you out of here.

speaker: Terese
text: 嗯。我相信你。
text_en: Mm. I trust you.

speaker: 旁白
text: Terese终于松开手。Carol把手递到她面前，等她握住。
text_en: Terese finally let go. Carol held out her hand and waited for her to take it.

speaker: Carol
text: 还能走吗？有没有哪里受伤？
text_en: Can you walk? Are you hurt anywhere?

speaker: Terese
text: 能走。没受伤，就是有点怕。
text_en: I can walk. I'm not hurt, just a little scared.

speaker: Carol
text: 那就跟在我后面，别乱跑，也别松手。
text_en: Stay behind me. Don't run off, and don't let go.

speaker: Terese
text: 好。你去哪儿，我就跟到哪儿。
text_en: Okay. I'll go wherever you go.

speaker: Carol
text: ……现在倒是听话了。
text_en: ...You're obedient now, at least.

speaker: Carol
text: 楼下的路还能走吗？
text_en: Can we still use the way downstairs?

speaker: Terese
text: 他们把下面的员工通道锁上了。309也得先经302登记，再用保洁身份开门；我没有员工证，没法自己离开。不过五楼有消防出口，我听夜班的人说过。
text_en: They locked the staff passage below. Room 309 also needed approval at Room 302 and an active Cleaner ID to open; I have no staff ID, so I couldn't leave on my own. But there's a fire exit on the fifth floor; I heard the night staff talk about it.

speaker: Carol
text: 那就上五楼。
text_en: Then we go to the fifth floor.

speaker: Terese
text: 这次换我帮你认路。
text_en: This time, I'll help you find the way.

speaker: Carol
text: 行。看见不对劲就告诉我，别自己往前冲。
text_en: All right. If anything feels wrong, tell me. Don't rush ahead on your own.

speaker: Terese
text: 知道啦。等出去了，我请你吃饭。
text_en: I know. When we get out, dinner is on me.

speaker: Carol
text: 一顿可不够。
text_en: One dinner won't be enough.

speaker: Terese
text: 那就很多顿。以后你需要我，我也一定会来。
text_en: Then lots of dinners. If you need me later, I'll come for you too.

speaker: Carol
text: 先把自己照顾好。
text_en: Take care of yourself first.

speaker: 旁白
text: Carol把她往身后带了带，先一步望向门外。
text_en: Carol drew her behind her and looked out the door first.

speaker: Carol
text: 走了。我带你出去。
text_en: Let's go. I'll get you out.

speaker: Terese
text: 嗯，跟着你。
text_en: Mm. I'll follow you.
